# Nanoscopy at low light intensities shows its potential

## Authors

- Travis J Gould<sup>1</sup>
- Joerg Bewersdorf<sup>2</sup> †

### Affiliations

1. Department of Cell Biology and the Kavli Institute for Neuroscience Yale University School of Medicine New Haven United States travis.gould@yale.edu
2. Departments of Cell Biology and Biomedical Engineering, and the Kavli Institute for Neuroscience Yale University School of Medicine New Haven United States joerg.bewersdorf@yale.edu

† Corresponding author

## Abstract

A new form of green fluorescent protein allows super-resolution imaging to be performed faster on living cells with low radiation doses.
